qualification.education_qualification: Degree in Law with legal training or knowledge of laws, Professional degree/diploma in psychology/psychiatry/neurosciences, Bachelor in Law/Social Work/Social Sciences/Psychology, Literate with knowledge/experience in relevant domain (High School preferred), Experience as security personnel (retired military/para-military preferred)
qualification.details: Para legal Personnel /lawyer: Any person having a degree in Law/ with legal training or knowledge of laws with at least 3 years' experience of working within a government or non-government women related project/programme at the district level or to any practicing Lawyer with at least 2 years' experience of litigation in any court of law. Psycho-Social Counselor (women only): Any woman having professional degree / diploma in psychology / psychiatry / neurosciences with a background in health sector and preferably with at least 3 years' experiences of working within a government or non-government health project/programme at the district level. Case Workers: Any women having a Bachelor in Law / Social Work / Social Sciences / Psychology with at least 3 years' experience of working on women related relevant domains in a government or non-government Project/programme. Multi-Purpose staff (Helper): Any person who is literate with knowledge / experience of working in the relevant domain. High School pass or equivalent will be preferred. Security Guard/Night Guard (women only): Any person having at least 2 years' experience of working as security personnel in a government or reputed organization at the district/state level. He/she should preferably be retired military / para-military personnel.

salary_details.details: Para legal Personnel /lawyer: Rs. 20000/- Per Month Psycho-Social Counselor (women only): Rs. 20000/- Per Month Case Workers: Rs. 19500/- Per Month Multi-Purpose staff (Helper): Rs. 13000/- Per Month Security Guard/Night Guard (women only): Rs. 15000/- Per Month

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for DWCWEO Chittoor Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://chittoor.ap.gov.in.

Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://chittoor.ap.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DWCWEO Chittoor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the DWCWEO Chittoor Various Posts is 17th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 12 vacancies are available for Various Posts in the One Stop Centre under the District Women and Child Welfare and Empowerment Chittoor.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it via post or as instructed in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the candidates?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for all posts is 25 years, and the maximum age limit is 42 years. Age relaxation will be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the different posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 13,000/- to Rs. 20,000/- per month, depending on the specific post. For example, Para legal Personnel and Psycho-Social Counselor posts offer Rs. 20,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any application fees for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there are no application fees mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: Educational qualifications vary by post, including degrees in Law, Psychology, Social Work, Social Sciences, or being literate with relevant experience. Specific details are provided in the eligibility criteria section.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an Oral Interview, followed by the preparation of a Merit List based on the performance of the candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any specific requirement for the Psycho-Social Counselor post?
faq.answer: Yes, the Psycho-Social Counselor post is exclusively for women and requires a professional degree/diploma in psychology/psychiatry/neurosciences with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of District Women and Child Welfare and Empowerment Chittoor, which is https://chittoor.ap.gov.in.
